Which Inter paper do you believe? We scored every claim the Italian press printed this week.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=61

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Sky Sport Italia (Oct 27) said Hakan Çalhanoğlu would be rested at Venezia. Chivu sent him on at half-time with the match goalless (Chivu via Sky Sport Italia, Oct 28).
TOOK IT BACK — Corriere dello Sport (Oct 25) had Curtis Jones and Benjamin Pavard back for Feyenoord. On Nov 1 the same paper puts both among five absences, with Como on Nov 8 the likelier date (Corriere dello Sport via FCInter1908).
REPORTED — Gazzetta dello Sport (Oct 27) says the Federico Dimarco renewal has not moved since September. Dimarco: “Purtroppo non abbiamo ancora parlato di rinnovo” — unfortunately we still haven't talked about a renewal.
STILL OPEN — eight of the week's ten reported claims have had nothing from the club either way. Inter have published no injury list of their own.
